summaries.title: Evolving Deeper LLM Thinking
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**推理与测试时计算**（Reasoning & TTC）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Evolving Deeper LLM Thinking** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、测试时计算扩展（Test-Time Compute Scaling）。核心论点主张：The proposed approach, Mind Evolution, uses a language model to generate, recombine and refine candidate responses。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：The proposed approach avoids the need to formalize the underlying inference problem whenever a solution evaluator is available。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **98%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Controlling for inference cost, we find that Mind Evolution significantly outperforms other inference strategies...；In the TravelPlanner and Natural Plan benchmarks, Mind Evolution solves more than 98% of the problem instances...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为社区高关注度代表作（HF 115 赞），本工作为突破 **全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: PaSa: An LLM Agent for Comprehensive Academic Paper Search
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**智能体与代码工程**（Agents & SWE）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **PaSa** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、合成数据（Synthetic Data）。核心论点主张：We introduce PaSa, an advanced Paper Search agent powered by large language models。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用强化学习策略优化与奖励驱动对齐、高质量合成数据构造与精选配比。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测；实验规模与算力/平台配置涉及 **7B**。实验设计与验证细节：We optimize PaSa using reinforcement learning with a synthetic dataset, AutoScholarQuery, which includes 35k fine-grained academic queries and corresponding papers...。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：关键量化指标达到 **37.78%, 39.90%, 30.36%, 4.25%**；核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Notably, PaSa-7B surpasses the best Google-based baseline, Google with GPT-4o, by 37.78% in recall@20 and 39.90%...；It also exceeds PaSa-GPT-4o by 30.36% in recall and 4.25% in precision）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 54 赞），本工作为突破 **合成数据与精细化配比 (Data Curation)、全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 中的「性能-开销瓶颈」提供了可迁移的建模配方；已开源代码/模型仓库，具备直接复现与工程接入条件。

summaries.title: Multiple Choice Questions: Reasoning Makes Large Language Models (LLMs) More Self-Confident Even When They Are Wrong
summaries.perspective:
本研究聚焦于**推理与测试时计算**（Reasoning & TTC）赛道，属于实证与机理剖析。针对当前领域面临的「现有方法在复杂场景下的性能与效率权衡」痛点，作者围绕 **Multiple Choice Questions** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)），并引入 LLMs are Multiple Choice
Question (MCQ) 等关键机制。核心论点主张：In this paper, we study how the LLM confidence in its answer depends on whether the model has been asked to answer directly or to provide the reasoning before answering。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：To help the LLM answer, a few examples called few shots can be included in the prompt。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（The results of the evaluation of questions on a wide range of topics in seven different models show that LLMs are more confident in their answers when they provide reasoning before the...）。
summaries.takeaway: 作为具有代表性的前沿探索（HF 32 赞），本工作修正了对 **全面评测基准与排行榜 (Holistic Benchmarks)** 的经验性直觉假设，为后续算法改进指明了真正起作用的因果关键点；提供了清晰的算法/评测设计范式参考。

summaries.title: ComplexFuncBench: Exploring Multi-Step and Constrained Function Calling under Long-Context Scenario
summaries.perspective: 本研究聚焦于**智能体与代码工程**（Agents & SWE）赛道，属于算法与架构创新。针对当前领域面临的「长程上下文建模与远距历史记忆衰减、系统性评测缺失与内在作用机理不明」痛点，作者围绕 **ComplexFuncBench** 展开攻关，核心切入概念涵盖大语言模型（Large Language Model (LLM)）、工具调用（Tool Use）。核心论点主张：In this work, we introduce ComplexFuncBench, a benchmark for complex function calling across five real-world scenarios。
summaries.experiments: 技术路线上采用针对性模型架构设计与多维受控实验验证。结合代表性公开任务与受控消融设置开展系统评测。实验设计与验证细节：However, evaluating the function calling abilities of LLMs in real-world scenarios remains under-explored due to the complexity of data collection and evaluation。
summaries.conclusions: 实证分析表明：核心实验发现验证了所提方案的有效性与边界条件（Through comprehensive experiments, we demonstrate the deficiencies of state-of-the-art LLMs in function calling and suggest future directions for optimizing these capabilities）。
